translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ID POKITA
book.title: DOS ID POKITA ni Disas Krays ki Juan

content: Dos Koddoong diyot Datas to Langit

Na nopongnga idda, nokita ku no duwon sobbangan no noukatan diyot datas to langit. Woy norinog ku mandon iddos bawos iling to dohingon to trumpeta no mid ungketen to, “Undini ka, su id pokita ku kikow iddos od kotomanan init morin allow.”
Idda ron en, no-iroomman a to kotuusan to Ispiritu to Monama, woy nopiyod a riyot datas to langit. Na rutun, nokita ku iddos trunu woy dos mid unsad tadda.
Dos boyo rin, iling to mosella no mahaa no mgo batu nod ngoranan no haspe
Diyot kandin no trunu, duwon bountu no nokolingkus iling to mosella no mahaa no batu nod ngoranan no esmeralda.
Na, duwon mandad oruwompuu-oppat no trunu no nokolingkus taddon trunu. Dutun, duwon id pon-ounsad no oruwompuu-oppat nod pombuyyahon no id pon-oumpak to moputi woy id kokuruna to buawan.
Pomon diyot nokotongannan no trunu, id kokilat, id lolouhung woy id pomaansi. Diyot isowwan tadda, duwon pittun suu no id ponloglog. Ini en kos Ispiritu to Monama.

Diyot isowwan to trunu, duwon immat lanow no motingngow iling to oungan. Na, duwon oppat no ma-antoy'n binovallan no nokolingkus diyon to ipat ibpit taddon trunu. Dos mgo lawa ran, noso-ob to mgo mata riyot isowwan woy riyon mandad to oyyug.
Iddos unnon ma-antoy'n binovallan, iling to boyo to liyun. Woy dos iko-oruwa, iling to boyo to turun baka, dos iko-otollu, iling to bonnong to minuvu woy dos iko-oppat, iling to banug nod layang.
Ipat sokkad kandan, duwon annom no pakpak, woy noso-ob idda to mgo mata ahad diyot silob to pakpak dan. Na allow bulli, waa soroan dan to kodkanta no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Uhis, uhis, uhis kos Monama nod Longaggon no Motuus to Langun.
Duwon don sikandin to waa pa iddos tigkonayan to ingod, ahad ko-ungkay, woy taman to waad tomanon.”

content: Na iddos mgo ma-antoy'n binovallan, id kanta, id posivantug woy id posolamat taddot mid unsad diyot trunu no ma-antoy taman to waad tomanon. Laggun tod puungan dan idda,
od ponlingko-od mandad iddos oruwompuu-oppat nod pombuyyahon diyon to isowwan taddot mid unsad diyot trunu, woy id ponsimba ran kandin no ma-antoy taman to waad tomanon. Na, id savuk
dan kos mgo kuruna ran diyot isowwan to trunu, woy mid ikahi sikandan to,

content.text: Ollog ka en nod doongon woy'd posivontuhon pomon to kotuusan du,
oyyos sikkow kos mid bovaa to langun.
Pomon to kikow'n id kopi-i, novovallan idda woy id boggayan du to umuu.”

footnotes.text: Otik diyot Griego no kinohiyan, pittun Ispiritu.Atag to kodpaabbotlabbot ka-ay, bosa-aw riyot dosiyung no lokkeb to Id Pokita 1:4-5b.
Ini en kos patow no od poobbava sikandan diyot isowwan to Monama.
